intro.text: Hi there. Here is a quick tour of Brewline, where every coffee order lives.

outro.text: That's Brewline. Fresh orders, shipped fast.

lines.text: The counters at the top show what is waiting to ship.
New orders are marked in yellow.
Click any order to open it.
The customer is notified, and the counters update.
Type the name, and click Create order.
It lands at the top of the board.
